contracts.necessity: LocalHold's sqlite-vec indexes require the extension on every SQLite connection. sqlite-vec 0.1.9 exposes its linked initializer only as an erased C function pointer, while SQLite registration requires the typed initializer ABI.
safe_alternatives_tried: rusqlite::auto_extension::register_auto_extension is used for registration and error handling, but it still requires a typed RawAutoExtension supplied by the caller.
sqlite-vec 0.1.9 has no safe Rust registration helper and does not export its initializer with the typed SQLite signature.
Runtime loadable-extension APIs are also unsafe, change deployment and trust boundaries, and do not remove the need to validate the native entrypoint.

invariants.validity: sqlite3_vec_init is a non-null function pointer to the statically linked symbol from the pinned sqlite-vec package.
invariants.lifetime: The linked sqlite3_vec_init symbol has process lifetime; SQLite may retain the registered pointer for all later connection opens.
invariants.aliasing: The Rust operations do not dereference or retain SQLite pointers. When invoked, the native initializer must use SQLite's supplied database, error-message, and API pointers only under SQLite's extension-init contract and must not retain invalid aliases.
invariants.abi: sqlite-vec 0.1.9's bundled sqlite-vec.h declares sqlite3_vec_init(sqlite3*, char**, const sqlite3_api_routines*) -> int, matching rusqlite 0.40.1 RawAutoExtension and libsqlite3-sys 0.38.1. The Rust sqlite-vec declaration erases that signature, so the exact dependency pins and proof debt are part of this invariant.
invariants.threading: LocalHold serializes registration with OnceLock and never cancels or resets the auto-extension. The native initializer must remain valid when SQLite invokes it during concurrent connection opens and must not open another database or mutate the auto-extension list.
invariants.supported_targets: The C declaration, compiled symbol, and rusqlite RawAutoExtension ABI must match on each supported LocalHold target. A new target, SQLite build route, sqlite-vec feature route, or calling-convention change requires renewed review.

caller_preconditions: Only SqliteStore::register_extension registers the initializer, before each constructor opens its connection.
Registration is never called from an SQLite auto-extension callback.
The pinned sqlite-vec, rusqlite, and libsqlite3-sys versions and their build routes have not changed.
No code cancels, resets, replaces, unloads, or dynamically shortens the lifetime of the registered initializer.
contracts.safe_wrapper_boundary: SqliteStore::register_extension is safe because OnceLock performs at most one registration attempt, owns no borrowed data, retains the linked function for process lifetime, caches failure, and exposes only Result<(), StoreError>.
contracts.build_route: The root enables rusqlite's bundled SQLite route through libsqlite3-sys. The checksum-pinned sqlite-vec build script compiles its bundled sqlite-vec native source and exposes the linked sqlite3_vec_init symbol.
review_invalidation_triggers: Any pinned dependency version, source, checksum, root dependency specification, enabled feature, native build route, or supported target changes.
Any unsafe site locator, fingerprint, exception reason, operation list, invariant, precondition, or wrapper boundary changes.
Any code begins cancelling or resetting SQLite auto-extensions, unloading the linked library, or invoking registration from an extension callback.
contracts.upstream_removal_trigger: Remove the transmute when sqlite-vec exports a correctly typed initializer or a reviewed safe registration API. Reassess whether auto-extension registration remains necessary whenever sqlite-vec or rusqlite changes this API.
proof_debt: Rust type checking proves only sqlite-vec's erased extern C declaration, not its parameter or return types.
The bundled header is evidence for the intended ABI, but this gate does not independently prove that the linked native symbol was built from that declaration.
The focused runtime test proves successful registration and invocation on the tested build; it cannot by itself prove absence of ABI undefined behavior on every target.

operations.description: Retype sqlite-vec's erased unsafe extern C function pointer as rusqlite::auto_extension::RawAutoExtension.
operations.safety_argument: Function pointer validity and lifetime are unchanged. The operation is sound only while the pinned native sqlite3_vec_init symbol has the exact ABI declared by sqlite-vec.h and RawAutoExtension.

operations.description: Register the typed initializer with rusqlite's process-wide SQLite auto-extension wrapper.
operations.safety_argument: The initializer follows rusqlite's callback restrictions, remains valid for process lifetime, and registration is serialized and never manipulated from inside the callback.
